notes.title: IROTORIDORI NO SEKAI - THE COLORFUL WORLD RELEASE DATE AND GIVEAWAY!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We are super excited for our first game developed by FAVORITE!
IROTORIDORI NO SEKAI - THE COLORFUL WORLD will be released on Friday the 16th of February!
Check out the store page and put it on your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2591380/Irotoridori_No_Sekai__The_Colorful_World/

notes.title: MY KLUTZY CUPID RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Our first game by Hulotte will be released in 2 weeks, on the 21st of July!
Join the protagonist's ordinary life turned upside down when a quirky angel of love drops a magical Love Note. Can they find true love within 90 days or face eternal impotence? Get ready for a heartwarming journey! ❤️✨
Go and wishlist it now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2370540/My_Klutzy_Cupid/

notes.title: HELLO LADY! RELEASE NEXT WEEK!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Are you excited already for our next game?
This time it's our first visual novel made by AKATSUKI-WORKS!

"It's the Dawn of a New Age-

The 21st century has brought about its own slew of problems for society at large.
As a result, the most promising youths from around the world have been gathered and enrolled in Amakawa Noble Academy. The curriculum at The Academy is designed to teach students how to use their talents to lead humanity toward a brighter future."

Standing at the apex of Amakawa Noble Academy are five beautiful young girls known as "Crowns."

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1751630/Hello_Lady__Complete_Edition/

The game will be released on Friday, January 21st, 2022 at 02:00 AM PST / 11 AM CEST, so don't forget to put it on your wishlist!
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33069582/7adf20441e8c508a9f65955ba6ebbceb864e1709.png

If you want to know more about the game visit our product page: https://hello.nekonyansoft.com/
